usedFor: TagMango holds creator orders and course progress, and Freshsales Classic receives changes to deals through “Update Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in TagMango, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A new order is the moment a deal's stage or amount should change.

watchOut: “Incomplete Order Created” in TagMango also triggers “Update Deal”, so separate unfinished orders from completed ones.
